about.title: Associate Consultant – Agentic AI & RAG | KPMG
about.shortBio: Associate Consultant & AI Engineer building production multi-agent systems, Agentic RAG pipelines, and enterprise test automation with Google ADK & Gemini.
about.description: Associate Consultant and AI engineer with hands-on experience building agentic AI systems, multi-agent pipelines and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Gemini models, Pinecone and Google Cloud Platform. Experienced in LLM-powered test automation, prompt engineering, knowledge graphs and enterprise integrations (SAP, Salesforce, Jira, Xray), with a strong foundation in machine learning and full-stack development. Delivers production-ready AI applications that solve real-world enterprise problems, from automated test case generation to orchestrated agent-to-agent workflows and citation-backed document Q&A.

focusAreas.title: Multi-Agent Systems & Google ADK
focusAreas.description: Designing production multi-agent pipelines, inter-agent communication protocols, and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations using Google ADK and Gemini.

focusAreas.title: Agentic RAG & Knowledge Graphs
focusAreas.description: Architecting citation-backed retrieval pipelines with document ingestion, deduplication, Pinecone vector embeddings, and interactive Knowledge Graph extraction.

focusAreas.description: Integrating GenAI and autonomous testing agents with SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP Hybris, Salesforce, Jira, Xray, and Playwright across CI/CD pipelines.

focusAreas.title: Full-Stack & ML Engineering
focusAreas.description: Delivering end-to-end applications using Python, Java Spring Boot, Angular, React, PyTorch, OpenCV, and Google Cloud Platform.

experience.title: Associate Consultant – Agentic AI & RAG
experience.description: Leading architecture and delivery of production multi-agent AI systems and enterprise RAG pipelines on Google Cloud Platform.
highlights: Design and build production multi-agent AI systems with Google ADK and Gemini models on Google Cloud Platform to automate enterprise QA and test orchestration.
Architect RAG and agentic retrieval pipelines, covering document ingestion, deduplication, embeddings and vector storage, to ground LLM answers in enterprise knowledge.
Integrate AI agents with SAP ECC/S4HANA, SAP Hybris, Salesforce, Jira and Xray to automate test design, execution tracking and reporting across enterprise landscapes.
Engineer and tune prompts and agent instructions for enterprise-grade QA pipelines, working closely with QA leads and stakeholders to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.

experience.title: Analyst – Agentic AI & Test Automation
experience.description: Architected multi-agent test automation workflows and inter-agent communication protocols using Google ADK and Gemini.
highlights: Architected and delivered multi-agent AI solutions for test automation using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Gemini, reducing manual testing effort by streamlining end-to-end test orchestration.
Designed inter-agent communication protocols for multi-agent systems, improving pipeline throughput and reducing handoff latency across agent boundaries.
Led prompt engineering initiatives to generate human-readable, enterprise-grade test cases via LLMs, cutting test authoring time significantly.
Collaborated with QA leads to integrate GenAI tooling into existing CI/CD pipelines, increasing automation coverage across test cycles.

experience.title: Consulting Intern – Generative AI & Test Automation
experience.description: Contributed to LLM-powered test case generation tooling and completed intensive Java Full-Stack engineering delivery.
highlights: Contributed to a GenAI solution that automated test case generation for enterprise software, reducing manual test authoring effort through LLM-powered generation.
Applied prompt engineering and few-shot techniques to improve test case accuracy and readability across heterogeneous enterprise application domains.
Built and integrated GenAI tooling into existing testing pipelines, improving test coverage scalability for large-scale deployments.
Completed intensive Java Full Stack training (Spring Boot, Angular, MySQL), directly applied in full-stack project delivery within the same internship period.

major.name: Agentic RAG with Knowledge Graph
major.subtitle: Citation-Backed Document Q&A & Interactive Graph Explorer
major.description: An end-to-end agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform built with Google ADK and Pinecone that ingests documents, answers queries with grounded source citations, and visualizes extracted entity-relationship Knowledge Graphs.
highlights: Built an agentic RAG system with Google ADK that ingests user-provided documents, runs the full RAG pipeline and answers user queries with source citations.
Used Pinecone as the vector database for embedding storage and semantic retrieval, enabling accurate, grounded answers over uploaded documents.
Generated and visualized an interactive Knowledge Graph of entities and relationships extracted from documents, helping users explore content beyond Q&A.
Deployed the backend on Render and the frontend on Netlify, delivering a live, end-to-end AI web application.

major.name: AI-Powered MediKit
major.subtitle: Multi-Modal Deep Learning Medical Assistant
major.description: A multi-modal healthcare assistant combining Vision Transformer (ViT) for medical image diagnosis, MFCC audio analysis for heartbeat classification, and a text-similarity clinical chatbot.
highlights: Built a multi-modal medical assistant combining Vision Transformer (ViT) for image diagnosis, MFCC for heartbeat analysis, and a text-similarity chatbot—demonstrating end-to-end deep learning system design.
Implemented few-shot tablet classification and herbal remedy search, enabling robust diagnosis under low-data constraints typical of rural telehealth scenarios.
Proposed YOLO-based real-time diagnosis and GenAI-powered medical bots as scalable extensions, with a hardware roadmap for vital-sign monitoring.

major.name: Appointment Booking System
major.subtitle: Full-Stack Healthcare Scheduling Platform
major.description: A role-based full-stack hospital appointment booking platform with dynamic scheduling logic, live doctor slot availability, and post-appointment review workflows.
highlights: Developed a full-stack booking platform enabling patients to select hospitals, departments, and doctor time slots, with live availability management and a post-appointment review workflow.
Designed a Spring Boot REST API backend with dynamic scheduling logic and an Angular SPA frontend, delivering a responsive, role-based user experience.

major.name: Google ADK Multi-Agent Suite
major.subtitle: Enterprise Tool-Augmented Agents & MCP Integrations
major.description: A comprehensive suite of intelligent, tool-augmented agents built using Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), integrating browser automation, financial analytics, web crawling, and MCP servers.
highlights: Developed autonomous Playwright Browser Automation Agents, Financial MCP Agents, Crawl4AI Web Extraction Agents, and Streamlit Code-Generation Agents.
Implemented custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) adapters enabling seamless communication between Gemini-powered ADK agents and external services.

major.name: CMS Voice Agent
major.subtitle: Conversational Voice-Driven AI Agent
major.description: Real-time voice-enabled AI agent designed to streamline content management workflows and interactive voice-driven task execution.
highlights: Engineered low-latency voice interaction pipelines connecting speech recognition, agentic reasoning, and synthesized responses for hands-free operations.

major.name: Dominance Pattern Classifier
major.subtitle: Interactive Genetic Inheritance ML Web App
major.description: A React-based Machine Learning application that classifies genetic inheritance patterns (Complete, Incomplete, and Codominance) using a custom-built Decision Tree algorithm.
highlights: Features synthetic dataset generation, real-time in-browser model training, interactive phenotype/genotype predictions, and Recharts visualizations.

major.name: Coconut Grove (Coco)
major.subtitle: Bilingual Plantation & Harvest Expense Tracker
major.description: A lightweight agricultural tracker to document coconut plantation progress through a photo gallery and manage harvest expenses with full English and Kannada localization.
highlights: Designed an intuitive mobile-friendly interface supporting bilingual switching (English & Kannada) for accessible farm record management.
